items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: So even Wayne King played sax on those days

ctx.x: Chicago band, right? Yeah, because mostly, mostly at that time, the range, the range were at the range, was the saxophones. Man, you heard most saxophones playing.
Yeah, but this is before, this is before Bud Friedman became very popular, I guess. Before Odd Castle. Oh, yeah. So even Wayne King played sax on those days, something like that.
